product.title: Vilvah Aloe Vera Gel Pack of 2 – Pure & Natural Multi-Purpose Gel for Face, Hair & Skin Hydration – Soothing, Lightweight, Non-Sticky
product.descriptionHtml:
• Pure and natural aloe vera gel formulated without parabens, silicones, or synthetic colors.
  • Provides instant hydration and cooling relief for dry, irritated, or sun-exposed skin.
  • Lightweight, non-sticky texture suitable as a daily moisturizer for face and body.
  • Works as a multipurpose hair gel – reduces frizz, adds shine, and nourishes scalp.
  • Value pack of 2 – convenient for home, travel, or sharing with family.
